notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Now Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874158/a8eeff70e9a837d8f7c9101191294968722ad858.png[/img]


Hey Chefs!
We have [b]Patch 1.1[/b] now live for you to download right away. The following is the breakdown:



[b]New stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added carrot to the editor
[*] Add in-game playtime timer (new options setting)
[*] Add hints to the hard-to-find graveyard coin making it easier to find
[*] Make bomb mortar targets more clear and deterministic
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix player being able to get stuck in phantasm precinct
[*] Fix rabbits magically turning into rollbits
[*] Fix objects being dragged along with sliding player
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874158/85f39f0f064e6dadeeea66a4485806aa55f40e06.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874158/9bc0855a7ef6b564422c833c2df3ab26f99528be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874158/c4bb19e1faca72ce452d26c821f1b26b16b95210.jpg[/img]


[b]Download and Play Today:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232010/Radical_Rabbit_Stew/
